relationships.subject: atogepant
relationships.evidence_quote: atogepant may relieve or prevent migraine not only by preventing vasodilation but also by preventing CGRP‐induced neurogenic inflammation

key_findings: Atogepant is a potent selective CGRP receptor antagonist acting mainly peripherally outside the BBB; effective for episodic and chronic migraine prevention.
